article.story: CHARLOTTE AMALIE, U.S. Virgin Islands -- — Erik Makke had 21 points in Stephen F. Austin’s 77-72 victory over Utah Valley on Monday at the Paradise Jam. Makke shot 6 of 10 from the field, including 5 for 7 from 3-point range, and went 4 for 6 from the line for the Lumberjacks (6-1). Gediminas Alisas scored 17 points while going 6 of 8 and 5 of 7 from the free-throw line, and added six rebounds. Marcus Scurry had 10 points and went 4 of 11 from the field (1 for 4 from 3-point range). Dominick Nelson led the way for the Wolverines (5-1) with 24 points, six rebounds and two steals. Utah Valley also got 23 points and eight rebounds from Isaac Davis. Alisas put up seven points in the first half for SFA in a 32-all tie. Makke’s 18-point second half helped SFA close out the victory. Up next: SFA’s next game is Tuesday against SMU on the road. Utah Valley hosts San Jose State on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
